label.purpose: Day stamps, tags, key captions, footer.

pixel.purpose: DAY stamp and the SJ wordmark. Never body.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Footer rule and media edge. The edge is the only elevation.

shadows.name: key-recess
shadows.purpose: Command-key face only. Not used on the page.

motion.name: key-press
motion.purpose: Command key face shifts 1px on press. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Command Key
components.description: Header jump to the journal. Light aluminum key, unlit well, no LED.

components.name: Day Stamp
components.description: Machine date with a Pixel DAY mark. Newest day is ink; older days are muted.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Muted mono word. No fill and no border.

narrative.overview: A near-white chronological journal. The page is mostly ground and type: generous space, a single reading column, machine day stamps, and almost no chrome. Hairlines appear only where a rule earns its place. The command key is a small light-aluminum object with an unlit well. Geist Pixel Square is a rare stamp, not a theme. This supersedes the anodized night log.
keyCharacteristics: Whitespace carries the groups; hairlines only at the footer and media edge
Command-key primary control, light aluminum, unlit well, no LED
Sparse Pixel accents: DAY beside the stamp, an inline SJ wordmark

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: The page stays inside #fafafa–#ffffff with #111111 type. Do not reintroduce a dark void, frosted panels, or a cyan wash.

rules.name: The No Signal Rule
rules.body: There is no chromatic accent. Focus is a 1px ink outline. Do not add cyan, blue LEDs, beige, terracotta, or a second neon.

rules.name: The Pixel Budget Rule
rules.body: Pixel Square is a fun display accent. A few uses per page: DAY beside the machine stamp, an inline SJ wordmark. If a sentence needs it, use Sans instead.

rules.name: The Geist Load Rule
rules.body: Titles, body, and UI are Geist Sans via geist/font/sans. Geist Mono via geist/font/mono is for machine stamps, tags, and technical labels. Geist Pixel Square via geist/font/pixel is the sparse accent. No Geist Serif. No Inter.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Do not put glass, blur, or inset color catches behind the header or day groups. If a region needs separation, use space first and a hairline second.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: Do not paint chromatic glows on type, cards, or the command key. The well on the key stays unlit.

rules.name: The Eight-Bit Wink Rule
rules.body: 8-bit is type only. Allowed: Geist Pixel Square on DAY and the SJ wordmark. Forbidden: scanlines, CRT overlays, chiptune, sprite backgrounds, pixelated photos, dithered embers, and pixelated frames.

dos: Do keep the column near 42rem and group by day.
Do leave more space between days than inside an entry.
Do write 1–2 curated sentences. Never raw chat.
Do treat Paper as media export only.
Do keep the command key unlit, and Pixel marks rare.
donts: Don't use a dark void ground, frosted glass panels, or a cyan chassis ember.
Don't use warm cream, beige, italic-serif decoration, Polaroids, or rubber-stamp dates.
Don't default type to Inter or load it from next/font/google.
Don't set body copy or long titles in Geist Pixel.
Don't put a blue or cyan LED on the Command key.
Don't pixelate photos or frames, or add scanlines and CRT overlays.
Don't use generic purple gradients, pulsing dots, equal-weight card grids, or vague marketing headlines.
Don't nest cards in cards or sprinkle chip soup.
Don't render paperRef or a Paper iframe.
